family_message: Cherry blossoms, a new house to dream about, and a Cleveland adventure. Spring break is here!

days.name: Sun 03/29
days.dinner_description: Classic Italian-American Sunday gravy with sausage over pasta — the kind of slow-simmered tomato sauce that fills the house with warmth on a cool spring evening.
days.album: Stevie Wonder – Songs in the Key of Life
days.album_title: Songs in the Key of Life
days.album_description: Widely considered the greatest album ever made. A sprawling, joyous masterwork that covers love, justice, spirituality, and everything in between — with grooves that never quit.
days.album_sonic_description: Expansive soul-funk-pop with Stevie's multi-instrumental genius — harmonica, Clavinet, synthesizers, gospel choirs, and grooves that range from intimate to anthemic
days.album_pairing_rationale: Sunday comfort food deserves the warmest album ever made. Stevie's soulful grooves are the musical equivalent of sausage gravy — rich, satisfying, and universally loved.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 94% sunshine, 1% precip, 14 mph wind (gusts to 25 mph)
calendar_items: Cherry blossom visit at the Tidal Basin

days.name: Mon 03/30
days.dinner_description: Intimate homemade pasta night — a simple, elegant Italian dish that lets the ingredients shine. Perfect for a cozy evening after a big day of house viewing.
days.album: Silk Sonic – An Evening with Silk Sonic
days.album_description: Bruno Mars and Anderson .Paak's retro-soul love letter is pure dinner-table gold — every track is a singalong waiting to happen. Fun, funky, and impossibly charming.
days.album_sonic_description: Lush retro soul with Motown strings, funky bass, crisp drum breaks, velvet harmonies, and production that sounds like a lost 1970s masterpiece
days.album_pairing_rationale: Intimate Italian pasta calls for smooth, flirtatious grooves. Silk Sonic's velvet harmonies are the perfect soundtrack for a quiet evening at home.
days.weather_detail: Cloudy — 20% sunshine, 42% precip, 15 mph wind (gusts to 32 mph)

days.name: Tue 03/31
days.dinner_description: Simple grilled chicken — the first real spring grilling day with sunshine and 79°F. Quick and easy before swim lessons.
days.album_description: Modern soul-funk collective from London. Jungle delivers danceable joy with sonic sophistication — the sound of stepping back into the sunshine after a long winter.
days.album_sonic_description: Modern disco-funk with falsetto vocals, retro synths, punchy brass, four-on-the-floor drums, and wall-to-wall groove
days.album_pairing_rationale: Sunny 79°F grilling weather meets sun-drenched disco-funk. Jungle's breezy optimism is the sound of spring finally arriving.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 97% sunshine, 20% precip, 15 mph wind (gusts to 35 mph)
calendar_items: Elsie's Level 4 Swim Lessons 6:00-6:30 PM (2310 Colts Neck Rd, Reston)

days.name: Wed 04/01
days.dinner_description: Homemade pizza night — everyone picks their toppings. A relaxed midweek dinner for the warmest day of the week so far.
days.album_description: George Clinton's P-Funk motherlode. Sci-fi funk mythology, some of the heaviest grooves ever recorded, and lyrics that'll have the whole table laughing and dancing.
days.album_sonic_description: Deep, heavy P-Funk with Bootsy Collins' rubbery bass, layered synthesizers, tight horn charts, and George Clinton's wild vocal performances
days.album_pairing_rationale: Pizza night is casual and fun — Parliament brings the cosmic party energy. Bootsy's bass is the perfect soundtrack for rolling dough and arguing about toppings.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 96% sunshine, 67% precip, 15 mph wind (gusts to 35 mph)

days.name: Thu 04/02
days.dinner_description: Breakfast for dinner! Crispy waffles with all the fixings. Another house viewing today keeps the excitement building — waffles are the perfect low-effort reward after a big day.
days.album_mood: Eclectic, passionate, funky, socially aware, joyful
days.album_description: Prince's double-album masterpiece — 80 minutes of funk, rock, soul, and pop from the most prolific genius in music history. Every track hits different; every groove is flawless.
days.album_sonic_description: Genre-omnivorous — Minneapolis funk, psychedelic rock, electronic pop, gospel soul, and stripped-down balladry, all played almost entirely by Prince himself
days.album_pairing_rationale: Breakfast for dinner is gloriously eclectic — just like Prince. His joyful party energy ('Housequake') matches the playful chaos of waffles at dinnertime.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 96% sunshine, 66% precip, 14 mph wind (gusts to 31 mph)

days.name: Fri 04/03
days.dinner_description: Flying to Cleveland! Dinner at Good Pizza — NY-style slices on E 4th Street. The Spicy Vodka pie ($26) is the hit, plus Margherita ($24) and Pepperoni with hot honey ($28). Casual, 4.8★, open till 10 PM. Don't skip the Cheesy Bread Loaf ($14.85) and Classic Tiramisu ($5.85).
days.album: The Soul Rebels – Poetry in Motion
days.album_description: New Orleans brass band that fuses hip-hop, funk, and soul into a high-energy brass party. Playing the 9:30 Club this week — perfect timing to discover them at dinner, then catch them live.
days.album_sonic_description: Brass-heavy funk with hip-hop beats, call-and-response vocals, New Orleans second-line rhythms layered with modern production
days.album_pairing_rationale: Travel day energy needs a brass band. The Soul Rebels' jubilant New Orleans funk is the perfect soundtrack for landing in a new city and hunting down great pizza.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 94% sunshine, 39% precip, 13 mph wind (gusts to 32 mph)
calendar_items: Dinner at Good Pizza (2057 E 4th St, Cleveland, OH 44115) — open Fri 11 AM–10 PM, (216) 400-9333

days.name: Sat 04/04
days.dinner_description: Exploring Cleveland! Dinner at Savage Burger — legendary smash burgers with Cajun fries and signature "savage sauce." Try the Classic Savage, Hawaiian Savage, or Super Savage. Open till midnight. Beyond Burger available for plant-based option.
days.album_description: Haitian-Canadian producer who makes house music that bumps and grooves like nothing else. A dinner party staple that bridges hip-hop, R&B, and electronic dance music.
days.album_sonic_description: Housey electronic production with deep bass, syncopated rhythms, R&B vocal features, and impossibly smooth transitions between tracks
days.album_pairing_rationale: Exploring a new city at night calls for groovy, nocturnal beats. Kaytranada's sophisticated cool matches the adventure of discovering Cleveland's best smash burgers.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 98% sunshine, 44% precip, 12 mph wind (gusts to 26 mph)
calendar_items: Dinner at Savage Burger (4259 Fulton Rd, Cleveland, OH 44144) — open Sat 11 AM–12 AM, (216) 415-5114
